title: A double free in XKB SetGeometryin X.Org X Server before 21.1.25 and X Wayland before 24.1.14 could be used by…
description: CVE-2026-88812 is a high-severity vulnerability involving a double free flaw in the XKB SetGeometry function of X.Org X Server versions before 21.1.25 and X Wayland versions before 24.1.14. This flaw could allow attached clients with limited privileges to cause a crash or potentially execute code within the X server context.
